author: driver
content:
Run InferPrintf.java on all 23 zen2 programs. The script scans for format strings, traces xrefs to find callee functions, and applies varargs char* fmt signatures to functions called with format strings at >=3 call sites.

Script: data/ghidra_scripts/InferPrintf.java
Command per program:
  ghidra-analyzeHeadless data/ghidra psp-etl/zen2 -process <NAME> -noanalysis -scriptPath data/ghidra_scripts -postScript InferPrintf.java 3

Programs to process: ABL1-7, ABL1_b-ABL6_b, PSP_FW_BOOT_LOADER, PSP_FW_BOOT_LOADER_b, PSP_FW_RECOVERY_BOOT_LOADER, PSP_FW_RECOVERY_BOOT_LOADER_b, PSP_FW_TRUSTED_OS, PSP_BOOT_TIME_TRUSTLETS (x4), DRIVER_ENTRIES

Blocked by Ghidra project lock — retry when user closes Ghidra GUI.
